run_f_gold: run f_gold to count strings made of R, G, and B using given combination parameters
test_f_gold: test f_gold against f_filled using the provided parameter sets and print success results
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use math.factorial instead of a manual factorial array
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which computes multinomial coefficient sums for R, G, B character combinations
review_f_gold: review f_gold for numerical precision issues with large factorial division values
